findings.finding: Mapping validation lacks actual audit-base to source ancestry. A source already merged and later deleted at the actual protected base can be admitted using an older claimed mapping base.
findings.reproduction: Independent isolated Git history returned empty audit errors before fix.
findings.required_resolution: Require actual protected base ancestor of source, and add historical-source negative fixture.

findings.finding: An old same-owner alias excuses an unmapped codec/metadata change at the original existing path.
findings.reproduction: Independent in-memory reviewed-function Git/blob mock returned errors=[] with no mapping.
findings.required_resolution: Only same-path equal metadata when path exists; alias compatibility only for actual deletion/rename. Add retained-alias negative fixtures.

findings.finding: Rollback assumes exclusive local writer and is not concurrency/crash recovery.
findings.reproduction: Independent fixture showed original bytes restored for single-writer injected failure, but competing writer bytes can be overwritten by rollback.
findings.required_resolution: Document serialized local mutation and interrupted-operation validation discipline; no DB semantics changed.

later_corrected_source_review.finding: Inherited original verification was selected-owner-only. An unrelated owner audit passed despite unavailable admitted source.
later_corrected_source_review.required_resolution: Reverify all admitted canonical mappings globally against each immutable recorded owner/base, preserving selected-owner-only new admission.

later_global_source_review.finding: Inherited global verification compared protected base and final head only. An unrelated owner could delete/change an admitted map or representation in an intervening commit and restore it before head.
later_global_source_review.required_resolution: Reverify immutable maps and original/replacement snapshots at every intervening revision/parent descended from protected base. Pre-admission side branches need no retroactive mapping existence.

later_c4_reviews.finding: A new foreign compact conversion/map can be added then entirely removed before head, leaving empty diff and selected-owner audit PASS.
later_c4_reviews.required_resolution: Discover new canonical maps globally at each revision and inspect changed compact representation history across owners; reject new foreign conversions even after restoration/deletion.

later_c4_reviews.finding: Path-only task/governance bookkeeping suffix checks allow valid reencoding/maps after review inside own review directory.
later_c4_reviews.required_resolution: Reject conversion records and existing compact representation mutation in tested/review suffixes at each commit. Permit ordinary newly captured independent review outputs.
